title: A safe URL builder
description:
Build request URLs without breaking them with spaces or symbols.

```
build("https://api.example.com", "/search", q="café & tea", page=2)
-> https://api.example.com/search?q=caf%C3%A9+%26+tea&page=2
build("https://api.example.com/", "users/ada lovelace")
-> https://api.example.com/users/ada%20lovelace
```

starter.main.py:
from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode


def build(base, path, **params):
    return base + path


print(build("https://api.example.com", "/search", q="café & tea", page=2))

hints: `base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path.lstrip("/")` joins without doubling the slash (lesson 1.05).
`{k: v for k, v in params.items() if v is not None}` drops the empty ones before `urlencode`.
requirements: Join the base and path with exactly one `/` between them.
Quote the path parts with `urllib.parse.quote` and the query with `urllib.parse.urlencode`.
Leave out query parameters whose value is `None`.
stretch: Accept a list value, like `tags=["a", "b"]`, with `urlencode(..., doseq=True)`.
